name: Integrated WTI Forecast
point_meaning: Median of the constructed log-return distribution; risk calibration preserves the selected price center.

delivery_scope.parameter_policy: Model coefficients, weights, calibration and preprocessing remain frozen as of 2026-09-30.
delivery_scope.input_policy: At each daily origin, update only observations already available under the publication rules.
delivery_scope.scope_change: User narrowed the delivery scope after reviewing October; this is not a new independent test or a new model selection.

module_roles.m1: Actual VECM forecast; residual-learning base, feature and convex candidate.
module_roles.m2: Actual monthly STL forecast; residual-learning base, feature and convex candidate, plus calendar/state interactions.
module_roles.lstm: Actual three-seed sequence forecast enters residual features and convex candidates.
module_roles.ml_point: Existing selected ML prediction plus newly fitted Ridge, Elastic Net and LightGBM residual corrections.
module_roles.ml_distribution: Historically selected ML scale/shape, fused-error calibration and 63 coherent quantiles; median unchanged.
module_roles.futures: Existing CL=F raw Close, delayed two US federal business days; separate stronger benchmark.

historical_inference.interpretation: Paired moving-block bootstrap of origin-level losses, blocks 20 and 60; exploratory conditional historical evidence, not a fresh prospective test.
historical_inference.base_selection_limitation: Base specifications use the full historical development window. Meta forecasts are coefficient-cross-fitted conditional on these specifications, not a fully nested unbiased historical test.
historical_inference.scope: Separate rolling horizons 1, 5, 20, 60; historical origins from 2025-09 onward.

source_audit.availability: Session quote + 2 US federal business days; never same-day OHLCV.
source_audit.limitation: Current-vintage unadjusted Close; verified overlap through EIA historical endpoint, not a complete point-in-time vendor archive.

limitations: Base specifications use the full historical development window. Meta forecasts are coefficient-cross-fitted conditional on these specifications, not a fully nested unbiased historical test.
Retrospective held-out evaluation; October was inspected in prior module work. No October observations or scores select fusion parameters.
Current-vintage unadjusted Close; verified overlap through EIA historical endpoint, not a complete point-in-time vendor archive.
Historical rolling h1 is better than lagged-futures carry; h5/h20/h60 remain worse than that stronger benchmark.
October rolling h1/h5 improve vs RW but do not beat v2; parameters were not changed using October outcomes.
Only 17/13 realized October outcomes at h1/h5. h20/h60 have no realized October outcomes; report no test error for them.
The 60-day point and risk forecasts remain weak; 90% interval coverage is not guaranteed.
All four point modules enter the fitted residual/combination system. Local sensitivity measures use, not beneficial out-of-sample contribution.
Historical confidence intervals do not correct for all prior research or full-window base-model specification selection.
